paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Teradyon — Gittin, chapter 7, halakhah 2.
Rabbi Chanina ben Teradyon — Avot, chapter 3, mishnah 2.
Rabbi Yitzchak ben Teradyon — Midrash Tehillim, chapter 31, section 6.

notes.text: These are three distinct name-and-reference attestations, not a single identified person.

Hyman supplies Gittin 7:2 for Elazar ben Teradyon and Midrash Tehillim 31:6 for Yitzchak ben Teradyon. The directly consulted named passages occur at Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:4 and digital Midrash Tehillim 31:4, respectively. Avot 3:2 directly names Chanina ben Teradyon. The English retains the supplied locators; these three notices do not identify a single person.
